title: Pastries
text: Fresh croissants and cinnamon buns are baked every morning at 6am. Vegan pastries are marked with a green leaf.

title: Wi-Fi
text: Free Wi-Fi is available in every shop. Since October the network is called MoonbeamFast and needs no password.

title: Events
text: Every Friday evening the Riverside shop hosts an open mic night from 6pm to 9pm.
